session.heading: Session
session.expiryWarning: [ Warning ] This session is about to expire — after that, everything in it is gone for good. Any action (voting, starting a story, revealing) extends it by another 24 hours.
session.rulesIntro: Planning poker is an estimation method for agile teams: everyone picks a card for a story's effort in secret. Only once everyone has voted are the cards revealed together.
session.rulesDiscussion: Large differences between estimates are the actual point of the exercise — they show where the team holds different assumptions, and are worth a short discussion. "Re-estimate" then starts a fresh vote for the same story.

admin.recoveryWarning: This link is shown exactly once. Use it to take the chair back if you switch browsers or clear your data. Save it now — after this it is gone.
